title: Bob Heinz, member of undefeated 1972 Dolphins' "No-Name Defense," dies at 79

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Bob Heinz, member of undefeated 1972 Dolphins' "No-Name Defense," dies at 79
sources.description: Bob Heinz, a member of the undefeated 1972 Miami Dolphins' "No-Name Defense" and winner of two Super Bowl rings, has died at the age of 79.
